The missing primitive

Your agent can be autonomous without being unaccountable.

Wallets gave agents the ability to act. Repayd gives the people around them a reason to let them.

01 · BOUNDARY

Make the safe path the easy path.

Policy is enforced at the account, not remembered in a prompt. Known recipients pass. Unknown destinations pause.

02 · EVIDENCE

Replace “trust me” with “open the receipt.”

Every action keeps its source, transaction, block, and reason. Chain evidence and local reasoning never blur together.

03 · RECOVERY

Design for the moment prevention misses.

A covered verdict calls a mutual pool and routes the payout back to the owner.

The live story

The agent can propose. It cannot decide alone. Follow one payment through policy, settlement, and proof.
